original_target.title: Complete EFX allocation of indivisible goods with additive values

verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.
scope_comparison: Original complete EFX0 allocation for all numbers of agents and goods under arbitrary nonnegative additive values. Current Alkassar–Fouz–Mehlhorn Theorem1 covers exactly4 agents and at most9 goods; three valuation-type, approximate-EFX, chores and nonadditive counterexamples do not settle the full quantifiers. Bounded current searches found no full match; not a certification of openness.
